quotes.quote: I am thankful for the rain… for hiding my emotions. Because we're spies, living in a world of shadows.
Ignorance isn't bliss. Ignorance is weakness. Ignorance is a sin.
A spy must always keep his emotions in check. If you lose your cool, you lose everything.
I will create a world where children don't have to cry.
I apologize for the intrusion, but…may I have the honor of taking your life?
